title.en: Methods of Credit Control: Quality & Quantity Control Measures
title.hi: Methods of Credit Control: Quality & Quantity Control Measures

definition.en: Credit control refers to the monetary policy tools employed by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to regulate the volume and direction of money supply and credit in the Indian economy.
definition.hi: Credit control refers to the monetary policy tools employed by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to regulate the volume and direction of money supply and credit in the Indian economy.

importanceInUpsc.en: Understanding these measures is essential for GS-3 as they form the backbone of India's monetary policy framework. Questions frequently appear on how these tools influence inflation, liquidity, and economic growth.
importanceInUpsc.hi: Understanding these measures is essential for GS-3 as they form the backbone of India's monetary policy framework. Questions frequently appear on how these tools influence inflation, liquidity, and economic growth.

learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish between quantitative and qualitative credit control instruments.
learningOutcomes.hi: Distinguish between quantitative and qualitative credit control instruments.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the impact of RBI's policy changes on the banking sector and the broader economy.
